package.description: PingTool is a powerful free utility for system administrators and network admins.

en-US.description: PingTool is a powerful free utility for system administrators and network admins.
en-US.longDescription:
It's more than just a simple ping tool: PingTool is able to check the availability of remote TCP
ports, perform LAN speed tests, wake up computers via Wake-on-Lan, scan the network and much more.
The tool is portable and only 3.0 MB in size.
en-US.name: PingTool
